item.coloph: zhi khro lha'i rdzong mkhar zhes bya ba/ gshen tshangs pa 'od 'gyed gyi ('byed kyis) zhi ba'i gsang gzungs la kha bzung nas gsungs pa'o/ khod spungs dran par man ngag snyan du brgyad pa'o/ khod spungs kyis phyi rab (rabs) don du yi ge bkod/ phyi rab (rabs) gshen gyis zang zang lha brag la sbas so/ yum sras lnga la gtad/ u ya/ shog ser gsum gdub dmar ser ba ldeb ma gsum la/ zhal bshus/ dpon gsas khyung rgod rtsal nas rim par brgyud do//
